_lisez_moi: Financial field labels (public/js/champs-financiers.js): « libelle » and « aide » for the datapack and tax-return reading, « ecran » and « aideEcran » on screen. Same keys as src/contenu/fr/champs.json.

chiffre_affaires.aide: Sales of goods + services sold (goods and services), income statement

autres_produits.aide: Inventoried and capitalized production, operating grants

achats_consommes.aide: Purchases of goods and materials, including changes in inventory

ebe.aide: Only if the breakdown of expenses is not available (INPI public accounts)
ebe.aideEcran: Only if you don’t break down your expenses: taken from the public accounts (French national business registry)

dotations_amortissements.aide: Depreciation and amortization of fixed assets

resultat_net.aide: Profit or loss for the fiscal year

stocks.aide: Inventories and work in progress, net value

creances_clients.aide: Customers and related accounts, net value

emprunts.aide: Bank loans, overdrafts, other financial debt

dettes_fiscales_sociales.aide: Excluding corporate income tax if possible

autres_dettes.aide: Excluding suppliers, tax and social security

aide_ebe: EBITDA (excédent brut d’exploitation): what the business generates before taxes, interest, depreciation and amortization.
